## Type

- [ ] False Positive (incorrectly flagged as risky)
- [ ] False Negative (missed a real risk)

## Domain

The domain that was misclassified.

## Expected Classification

What you expected the tool to report.

## Actual Classification

What the tool actually reported.

## Command Used

```
trustlint <domain> ...
```

## Additional Context

Any details about the certificate, chain, or network setup that may help reproduce the issue.
